messages:
riley: hey @people-ops :wave: — quick heads up, my chronic back flare-up got worse this morning. i'm struggling with long standups, commuting into the office, and heavy oncall shifts. would like to request a temporary accommodation: quiet workspace (or remote for a few weeks), ergonomic chair, and reduced pager duties for ~6–8 weeks. prefer this stays confidential for now. can we start ASAP?
hr_bot: Hi! For accommodations start here: https://redwood.example.com/accom-intake — you can submit a confidential intake form (takes ~5 min). If you prefer, DM @sam_people-ops and we can start intake manually. :white_check_mark:
sam_people-ops: Riley, sorry to hear — please DM me when you have a minute and we'll run through options. We can scope the accommodation without full docs initially; a short note from your provider helps but isn't required to begin temporary measures. We can also discuss taking you off oncall immediately if needed.
tess_manager: @riley I can reassign your oncall this week. I’ll swap you out for Friday and cover the handover. Happy to keep this private. :+1:
jordan: i can pick up a couple of your customer-facing tickets this sprint, riley. tell me which ones and i’ll own them.
morgan_oncall: @tess_manager if you need persistent coverage, i can trade Tues/Thu with riley for the next 4 weeks. no prob.
riley: Thanks everyone — dm'd @sam_people-ops with a short note. Prefer remote for now and the chair would be huge. I can push through today but prefer not to be oncall tonight if possible. Appreciate the support.
sam_people-ops: Got your DM, Riley — thanks. We'll mark an accommodation request in the HR tracker and set temporary adjustments: remote work approved starting today, ergonomic chair order (we'll coordinate shipping), and remove you from oncall tonight. Can you confirm mailing address via DM? We'll also put a private note on your profile so only People Ops + your manager see it.
tess_manager: Confirmed I'll handle the handover doc and remove Riley from the rota. @jordan please sync with me on ticket ownership.
jordan: will do, sending quick update in the tickets now.
sam_people-ops: Quick note on docs/process: if this becomes a longer-term need we may ask for a provider note to support the ongoing accommodation. For now, this is temporary and confidential. I'm scheduling a 30-minute check-in for tomorrow — calendar invite to follow.
riley: Sounds good. Thank you all — really relieved. small ask: can the team avoid mentioning this in public channels?
sam_people-ops: Absolutely. We'll keep the thread and notes private. Will follow up after the check-in with next steps and expected timeline for the chair order. If anything urgent comes up, DM me directly. :heart:
#end of thread
